articles.title_en: The Modern Wholesaler: Global Sourcing, Domestic Distribution, and Scale Economies
articles.title_cn: 现代批发商：全球采购、国内分销与规模经济
articles.abstract_en: Half of all transactions in the $6 trillion market for manufactured goods in the United States were intermediated by wholesalers in 2012, up from 32 percent in 1992. Seventy percent of this increase is due to the growth of “superstar” firms—the largest 1 percent. Estimates based on detailed administrative data show that the rise of the largest firms was driven by an intuitive linkage between their sourcing of goods from abroad and an expansion of their domestic distribution network to reach more buyers. Both elements require scale economies and lead to increased wholesaler market shares and markups. (JEL D22, D24, F14, L15, L60, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 在2012年，美国制成品市场中价值6万亿美元的交易中，有一半由批发商中介，高于1992年的32%。这一增长的百分之七十归因于“超级明星”企业——即最大的1%——的扩张。基于详细行政数据的估计显示，最大企业的崛起是由其从国外采购商品与扩大国内分销网络以覆盖更多买家之间的直观联系所驱动。这两个要素都需要规模经济，并导致批发商市场份额和加价率的提高。(JEL D22, D24, F14, L15, L60, L81)

articles.title_en: The Inner Workings of a Hub-and-Spoke Cartel in the Automotive Fuel Industry
articles.title_cn: 汽车燃料行业中轴辐式卡特尔的内在运作机制
articles.abstract_en: We study the inner workings of a hub-and-spoke cartel in the Brazilian automotive fuel industry. Based on court documents and detailed price and sales data, we discuss how gas station owners (spokes) operating inside the federal capital received help from fuel distributors (hub) to reduce dispersion of and increase gasoline’s retail price. We provide evidence that distributor cartel members benefited by raising wholesale prices while keeping competitors from supplying retail cartel members. We also provide theoretical foundations and empirical evidence for a new mechanism through which hubs help spokes: smoothing cost fluctuations. (JEL K21, L12, L22, L32, L71, L81, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了巴西汽车燃料行业中轴辐式卡特尔的内在运作机制。基于法院文件以及详细的价格和销售数据，我们讨论了在联邦首都内运营的加油站所有者（辐条）如何从燃料分销商（轴心）获得帮助，以减少汽油零售价格的离散度并提高其价格。我们提供的证据表明，分销卡特尔的成员通过提高批发价格并阻止竞争对手向零售卡特尔成员供货而获益。我们还为一种新机制提供了理论基础和经验证据，通过该机制轴心帮助辐条：平滑成本波动。（JEL K21, L12, L22, L32, L71, L81, O14）

articles.title_en: A Random Dictator Is All You Need
articles.abstract_en: We study information aggregation with a decision-maker aggregating binary recommendations from symmetric agents. Each agent’s recommendation depends on her private information about a hidden state. While the decision-maker knows the prior distribution over states and the marginal distribution of each agent’s recommendation, the recommendations are adversarially correlated. The decision-maker’s goal is choosing a robustly optimal aggregation rule. We prove that for a large number of agents for the three standard robustness paradigms (maximin, regret, and approximation ratio), the unique optimal aggregation rule is “random dictator.” We further characterize the minimal regret for any number of agents through concavification. (JEL D81, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究信息聚合问题，其中决策者聚合来自对称代理人的二元建议。每个代理人的建议取决于其关于隐藏状态的私人信息。虽然决策者知道状态的先验分布和每个代理人建议的边际分布，但建议之间是对抗性相关的。决策者的目标是选择一种稳健最优的聚合规则。我们证明，对于大量代理人，在三种标准稳健性范式（极大极小、遗憾和近似比）下，唯一最优的聚合规则是“随机独裁者”。我们进一步通过凹化刻画了任意数量代理人的最小遗憾。(JEL D81, D82, D83)

articles.abstract_en: I introduce a model of predictive scoring. A receiver wants to predict a sender’s quality. An intermediary observes multiple features of the sender and aggregates them into a score. Based on the score, the receiver makes a decision. The sender prefers “higher” decisions, and she can distort each feature at a privately known cost. I characterize the scoring rule that maximizes decision accuracy. This rule underweights some features to deter sender distortion, and overweights other features so that the score is correct on average. The receiver prefers this scoring rule to full disclosure because it mitigates his commitment problem. (JEL C72, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我引入了一个预测性评分的模型。接收者想要预测发送者的质量。一个中介观察发送者的多个特征并将其汇总为一个分数。基于该分数，接收者做出决策。发送者偏好“更高”的决策，并且她可以以私下已知的成本扭曲每个特征。我刻画了最大化决策准确性的评分规则。该规则低估某些特征以阻止发送者扭曲，并高估其他特征以使分数在平均意义上是正确的。接收者偏好这一评分规则而非完全披露，因为它缓解了他的承诺问题。(JEL C72, D82, D83)

articles.title_en: Eliciting Time Preferences When Income and Consumption Vary: Theory, Validation, and Application to Job Search
articles.title_cn: 当收入与消费变动时的时间偏好诱导：理论、验证及在求职中的应用
articles.abstract_en: We propose a simple method for eliciting individual time preferences without estimating utility functions even in settings where background consumption changes over time. It relies on eliciting preferences for receiving high stakes lottery tickets at different points in time. In a standard intertemporal choice model high rewards decouple lottery choices from variation in background consumption. We investigate robustness to other assumptions theoretically, and validate our elicitation method experimentally. We illustrate an application of our method with unemployed job seekers, which naturally have income/consumption variation. (JEL D12, D15, D91, G51, J22, J64)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种简单的方法，用于在不估计效用函数的情况下诱导个体时间偏好，即使在背景消费随时间变化的设定中也是如此。该方法依赖于诱导个体在不同时间点获得高额彩票的偏好。在标准跨期选择模型中，高额奖励使彩票选择与背景消费的变化脱钩。我们从理论上考察了该方法对其他假设的稳健性，并通过实验验证了我们的诱导方法。我们以失业求职者为对象展示了该方法的应用，这些求职者自然存在收入/消费变动。(JEL D12, D15, D91, G51, J22, J64)

articles.abstract_en: In the United States, electoral districts must be equipopulous. This requirement is known as the one man, one vote doctrine. We propose welfare-based justifications for this requirement under the economic view, according to which voters care about the policy, and under the political view, according to which voters care about representation. Both justifications assume that the districter is partisan. If the districter is benevolent, one man, one vote is harmless under the economic view but may reduce voter welfare under the political view by as much as the reduction from K to √K districts would. (JEL D71, D72)
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国，选区必须人口相等。这一要求被称为“一人一票”原则。我们在经济视角下提出基于福利的正当性论证，该视角认为选民关心政策；在政治视角下，选民关心代表性。两种论证均假设划分选区者具有党派性。如果划分选区者是仁慈的，那么在经济视角下，“一人一票”是无害的，但在政治视角下，它可能将选民福利降低至相当于从K个选区减少到√K个选区时的程度。（JEL D71, D72）

articles.title_en: Commitment and Conflict in Unanimity Bargaining
articles.title_cn: 一致同意谈判中的承诺与冲突
articles.abstract_en: We theoretically investigate how the application of unanimity rule can lead to inefficient delay in collective decision-making. We do so in the context of a distributive multilateral bargaining model featuring strategic precommitment. Prior to each bargaining round, players can declare a minimum share that they must receive in return for their vote. Such declarations become binding with an exogenously given probability. We characterize the set of stationary subgame perfect equilibria (SSPE) under all q-majority rules. Our results suggest that unanimity rule is uniquely inefficient. All other rules, including all-but-one, are fully efficient. (JEL C78, D71, D72, F53)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从理论上研究了一致同意规则如何导致集体决策中的低效拖延。我们在一个具有战略预承诺的分配性多边谈判模型中进行分析。在每一轮谈判之前，参与者可以声明他们必须获得的最低份额以换取其投票。这种声明以给定的外生概率成为有约束力的。我们刻画了所有q-多数规则下的平稳子博弈完美均衡（SSPE）集合。我们的结果表明，一致同意规则是唯一低效的。所有其他规则，包括除一人外的全体同意规则，都是完全有效的。（JEL C78, D71, D72, F53）

articles.title_en: Estimating Models of Supply and Demand: Instruments and Covariance Restrictions
articles.title_cn: 估计供需模型：工具变量与协方差约束
articles.abstract_en: We consider the identification of empirical models of supply and demand with imperfect competition. We show that a restriction on the covariance between unobserved demand and cost shocks can resolve endogeneity and identify the price parameter. We demonstrate how to employ this approach in estimation, and we compare it to the method of instrumental variables. Our formal results also indicate that weaker covariance restrictions can bound the price parameter. We illustrate the covariance restriction approach with applications to ready-to-eat cereal, cement, and airlines. (JEL C51, D12, L13, L61, L66, L93)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了在不完全竞争条件下经验供需模型的识别问题。我们证明，对未观测到的需求冲击与成本冲击之间协方差的约束可以解决内生性问题并识别价格参数。我们展示了如何在估计中采用这种方法，并将其与工具变量法进行比较。我们的正式结果还表明，较弱的协方差约束可以为价格参数提供边界。我们通过即食麦片、水泥和航空业的实例来说明协方差约束方法。(JEL C51, D12, L13, L61, L66, L93)

articles.title_cn: 三元组嵌入用于需求估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose a method to augment conventional demand estimation approaches with crowd-sourced data on the product space. Our method obtains triplets data (“product A is closer to B than it is to C”) from an online survey to compute an embedding—i.e., a low-dimensional representation of the latent product space. The embedding can either replace data on observed characteristics in mixed logit models, or provide pairwise product distances to discipline cross-elasticities in log-linear models. We illustrate both approaches by estimating demand for ready-to-eat cereals; the information contained in the embedding leads to more plausible substitution patterns and better fit. (JEL C45, C51, D11, D12, D21, L66)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种方法，将传统需求估计方法与关于产品空间的众包数据相结合。我们的方法通过在线调查获取三元组数据（“产品A比产品C更接近产品B”），以计算嵌入——即潜在产品空间的低维表示。该嵌入既可以替代混合logit模型中观测特征的数据，也可以提供成对产品距离来约束对数线性模型中的交叉弹性。我们通过估计即食麦片的需求来展示这两种方法；嵌入中包含的信息导致了更合理的替代模式和更好的拟合度。（JEL C45, C51, D11, D12, D21, L66）

articles.title_en: Long-Term Relationships in the US Truckload Freight Industry
articles.title_cn: 美国整车货运行业的长期关系
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence on the scope and incentive mechanisms of long-term relationships in the US truckload freight industry. In this setting, shippers and carriers engage in repeated interactions under fixed-rate contracts that allow for inefficient opportunism. The main dynamic mechanism involves shippers using the threat of relationship termination to deter carriers from short-term opportunism. This threat and the potential of future rents induce more carrier cooperation. We test this mechanism against likely alternatives and analyze relationship scope for different carrier types. We find that incentive schemes do not exploit the full temporal and spatial scope of relationships. (JEL D22, D82, L14, L92)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于美国整车货运行业长期关系的范围和激励机制的证据。在此背景下，托运人和承运人在固定费率合同下进行重复互动，这种合同允许低效的机会主义行为。主要的动态机制涉及托运人利用终止关系的威胁来阻止承运人的短期机会主义行为。这种威胁和未来租金的潜力促使承运人更多合作。我们针对可能的替代方案检验了这一机制，并分析了不同承运人类型的关系范围。我们发现激励方案并未充分利用关系的全部时间和空间范围。(JEL D22, D82, L14, L92)

articles.title_cn: 通过混合投注引出模糊性
articles.abstract_en: Preferences for mixing can reveal ambiguity perception and attitude on a single event. The validity of the approach is discussed for multiple preference classes, including maxmin, maxmax, variational, and smooth second-order preferences. An experimental implementation suggests that participants perceive almost as much ambiguity for the stock index and actions of other participants as they do for the Ellsberg urn, indicating the importance of ambiguity in real-world decision-making. (JEL C72, D11, D12, D81)
articles.abstract_cn: 对混合的偏好可以揭示单一事件上的模糊感知和态度。该方法在多种偏好类别中的有效性得到了讨论，包括最大最小、最大最大、变分和平滑二阶偏好。一项实验实施表明，参与者对股票指数和其他参与者行为的模糊感知几乎与对埃尔斯伯格瓮的感知一样多，这表明模糊性在现实世界决策中的重要性。（JEL C72, D11, D12, D81）

articles.title_en: Global Giants and Local Stars: How Changes in Brand Ownership Affect Competition
articles.title_cn: 全球巨头与本土明星：品牌所有权变化如何影响竞争
articles.abstract_en: Large beer and spirits makers expanded abroad mainly by acquiring local brands. Exploiting market share data in 76 countries and changes in brand ownership from 2007 to 2018, we estimate that owners matter little for brand performance, except via a negative consumer response to foreign ownership. Counterfactuals indicate that market power increases were large enough to yield higher profits for most mergers without relying on fixed-cost savings. Emulating procompetition policies used by the United States and European Union could have saved South American consumers up to 18 percent. US beer prices would be 3–4 percent higher without DOJ-enforced divestitures. (JEL F23, G34, K21, L13, L25, L66)
articles.abstract_cn: 大型啤酒和烈酒生产商主要通过收购本土品牌进行海外扩张。利用76个国家的市场份额数据以及2007年至2018年间品牌所有权的变化，我们估计所有者对品牌绩效的影响甚微，除了消费者对外国所有权的负面反应。反事实分析表明，市场力量的增强足以使大多数并购在不依赖固定成本节省的情况下获得更高利润。模仿美国和欧盟使用的促进竞争政策，本可为南美消费者节省高达18%的开支。如果没有美国司法部强制执行的资产剥离，美国啤酒价格将高出3-4%。（JEL F23, G34, K21, L13, L25, L66）
